subject: Draft MAP & evaluation checklist for Mediflow pilot
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@mediflow.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP & evaluation checklist for Mediflow pilot

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our convo I put together an initial mutual action plan (MAP) and an evaluation checklist to help the pilot run cleanly and surface go/no-go signals early. Attached are:

- Mediflow-MAP-v0.1.gdoc (editable) — objectives, stakeholders, 30/60/90 milestones
- Mediflow-Eval-Checklist.xlsx — acceptance criteria and metric definitions
- MAP-Playbook-Slides.pptx — 10-slide agenda and suggested workshop flow

High-level items in this draft:
- Pilot objective: validate Redwood’s private deployment and inference latency for Mediflow triage pipelines
- Success metrics: 95th percentile latency <= 250ms, end-to-end throughput to support X concurrent sessions, accuracy lift on intent routing >= 12% vs baseline
- Minimal scope for a 4-week pilot: 2 models (chat + reranker), 3 integration endpoints, synthetic load + 1 week of live traffic
- Risks / blockers: SOC2 evidence requests, data residency constraints, procurement window

Can you take a quick pass and share: (1) whether those success metrics map to your internal KPIs, (2) who the core stakeholders are on your side (product, security, procurement), and (3) if the proposed workshop time below works?

Proposed next step: 60-minute workshop to align scope and timeline — Wed 12/17 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 12/18 09:00–10:00 PT (we can shift if needed).

If you prefer, I can also trim scope for a faster 4-week narrow pilot; Marissa (CC) can share a recommended reduced-scope plan.

Thanks — looking forward to the feedback.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0147

Attachments: Mediflow-MAP-v0.1.gdoc (Google Doc link), Mediflow-Eval-Checklist.xlsx, MAP-Playbook-Slides.pptx

From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@mediflow.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & evaluation checklist for Mediflow pilot

Thanks Hannah — I reviewed the attachments quickly. A few rapid questions from procurement/security ahead of scheduling the workshop:

1) Procurement will need a baseline price estimate for the 4-week pilot and any potential overage terms. Can you send a ballpark?
2) We require SOC 2 evidence and a short summary of how telemetry/audit logs are handled for private deployments.
3) We may need to compress the timeline to 4 weeks. Is that realistic if we keep the full scope?

On timing: Fri 12/18 09:00–10:00 PT looks better for our team. Can you confirm and send a calendar invite?

— Sarah
Sarah Lewis
Head of Procurement | Mediflow
sarah.lewis@mediflow.com

Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 12:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & evaluation checklist for Mediflow pilot (internal notes)

Quick internal notes / suggested edits before workshop: 

- Tighten success metrics: change accuracy lift target to a relative +10–15% and add a stability metric (error rate < 0.5%)
- Add a short data residency note under compliance: proposed private deployment in us-west-2; if EU data required we recommend a separate footprint
- Procurement questions: we have a one-page procurement packet (attached) that lists pilot pricing bands and standard SOW language — send that to Sarah as a follow-up to the workshop
- Scope for a compressed 4-week pilot: reduce to 1 model (inference + reranker combined), one integration endpoint, 2 weeks live traffic window; Redwood dev time estimate: 3 engineer-weeks + 1 infra engineer for setup

Also: I drafted a brief paragraph to add to the MAP that addresses acceptance criteria and rollback conditions; happy to paste it into the GDoc and share a v0.2 after you approve.

Attachment: Procurement-Packet-Redwood-v1.pdf

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Draft MAP & evaluation checklist for Mediflow pilot — workshop confirmed (v0.2)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the quick reply and for flagging procurement/security. We can absolutely support a compressed 4-week pilot if Mediflow is comfortable with the reduced scope Marissa outlines (I pasted her bullets into the MAP and updated the success metrics). I've attached the updated doc (Mediflow-MAP-v0.2.gdoc) and included a short procurement packet link in the doc.

Confirmed workshop: Fri 18 Dec 2026, 09:00–10:00 PT — invite attached.

Immediate next steps:
- I will send the procurement packet and a ballpark pilot estimate before EOD today (Marissa: can you confirm the engineer-week estimate and a topline number?)
- Sarah: please share the stakeholder list (names + emails for product, security, procurement) so we can invite them to the workshop
- We'll finalize v0.2 during the workshop and aim to have an SOW draft within 48 hours of alignment

Thanks — looking forward to the workshop.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Manager | Redwood Inference
